out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please post the health department permit in a conspicuous location where customers can see it. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the hand sink behind the front counter being used as a dump sink and to fill water containers. Also, observe a coffee urn stored on top of the handwashing sink near the washing area, making it inaccessible.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Ensure that employees don’t use the hand sink as a dump sink. The manager stated he will designate another nearby sink as the hand sink instead. The person in charge move the coffee during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: smoked salmon is being offered raw on the classic salmon cheese dish.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. Serving undercooked fish requires a parasite destruction letter. The PIC obtained a PDL during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: diced chicken in the refrigerator was 44°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The diced chicken was discarded.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: raw salmon is being offered on the classic salmon cheese dish without a reminder statement on the menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: raw smoked salmon is being offered on the classic salmon cheese dish and there is no consumer advisory for it on the menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Label Information
violations.observation: Insufficient information is provided on the label of the following food item(s) packaged in the food establishment: baked goods, sandwiches and yogurt parfaits were not labeled as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. Provide labels for individual packages as soon as possible over before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Single-service items were observed reused for the storage and transport of foods. Observed that disposable aluminum, catering pans are being used to transport in store of foods, and that these pans are being reused.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items may not be reused. Just discontinue reusing, the aluminum catering pans. Instead, use washable equipment made of stainless steel or restaurant grade plastic or cambro.
